title: Meja Lapan
subject: being a guest at the wedding of someone you loved
caption: Malay alternative rock, heavy and modern. Drop-tuned electric guitars with thick palm-muted chugs doubled hard left and right, a dry punchy drum kit with the snare tuned high, sub bass tracking the guitar root, one clean guitar arpeggio exposed in the bridge. Mixed loud and compressed, guitars wide, drums forward. Strained male baritone, conversational in the verses and shouted raw in the chorus, cracking on purpose. 146 BPM, C sharp minor. Clenched, performing fine in public. No pop gloss, no synth, no rapping, no ballad section, no orchestral strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - drop-tuned guitar and drums]

[Verse 1]
Meja lapan, sebelah speaker
Aku dapat ayam, orang sebelah dapat ayam
Kau cantik. Aku dah agak kau akan cantik.
Aku datang sebab kalau tak datang, lagi pelik

[Pre-Chorus]
Tiga tahun aku latih muka ni
Hari ni je aku guna

[Chorus]
Aku tepuk tangan kuat
Aku tepuk paling kuat kat meja ni
Jangan pandang sini, jangan pandang sini
Aku okey bila kau tak pandang

[Verse 2]
Mak kau kenal aku, dia peluk aku lama sikit
Dia tak cakap apa-apa. Itu yang paling sakit.
Pengantin lalu, kain dia sentuh kaki kerusi
Aku tarik kaki aku. Refleks.

[Chorus]
Aku tepuk tangan kuat
Aku tepuk paling lama kat meja ni
Jangan pandang sini, jangan pandang sini
Aku okey selagi kau tak pandang

[Bridge - clean guitar alone]
Bunga telur aku bawa balik
Letak atas dashboard. Sampai cair.

[Outro - full band, cut]
Meja lapan dah kosong
[Song ends abruptly]
